Hold Throttle and Brake to drive. Tap Lane to change lane, or to override a pit route for one switch. Tap Pit for a stop. Defer appears when a pit visit can be put back one lap: it then becomes compulsory. Keep holding Brake once stopped to reverse slowly. Pit visits drive themselves: a stop-and-go is served in the box, then the car stops in your own bay. Lift off and press Throttle again when it says Ready to leave. Defer or Lane before the entrance skip a visit, and skipping a stop-and-go on its last allowed lap means DQ.
Defer the pit visit to next lap (once, never on the final lap) — it then becomes compulsory

Service rules: a stop-and-go, or a stop you deferred, must be served by the end of the lap it is due. Miss that and you are disqualified at the flag. Pit visits drive themselves: from 40 m before the pit entrance the car brakes and queues, serves a stop-and-go in the box, then stops in your own bay (your colour, your number) to refuel. To leave the bay, let go of Throttle and press it again once it says Ready; the car waits for a clear exit and hands back after the pit exit. Only N (Defer, if offered) or Space (if a switch is left) skip a visit — skipping a stop-and-go on its last allowed lap means DQ.
